mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wishlist (user_id, product_id, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, NOW()) ON CONFLICT (user_id, product_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM wishlist WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId}
mapper.select: SELECT w.wishlist_id AS wishlistId, w.user_id AS userId, w.product_id AS productId, w.created_at AS createdAt, p.name AS name, p.price AS price, p.image_url AS imageUrl, p.discount_price AS discountPrice FROM wishlist w INNER JOIN products p ON w.product_id = p.product_id WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY w.created_at DESC, w.wishlist_id DESC
